projectDescription: A unified Python API for time series foundation models — run forecast, cross-validation, and anomaly detection across Chronos, Moirai, TimesFM, Toto, and 12 other models through a single interface.
keyFeatures: Single FoundationForecast class runs 12+ pretrained foundation models through one API
Three unified methods: forecast(), cross_validation(), and detect_anomalies()
Known-future exogenous variables (X_df) on supported checkpoints: Chronos-2, TimesFM-3, TimeGPT, T0, TiRex-2
Probabilistic forecasting via level (prediction intervals) or quantiles
GPU-native — automatically runs on GPU when available without model-specific configuration
Process-wide LRU model weight cache with configurable size via set_max_cached_models()
Finetuning support for Chronos and TimeGPT at inference time
Fallback model support and clean_cache option for multi-model ensembles
Benchmark replication CI against GIFT-Eval and fev-bench leaderboards
